name: Steve Garcia

official.division_note: Featherweight (fought at lightweight earlier in his UFC run). Knocked out by Diego Lopes at UFC Freedom 250 (Jun 14, 2026); reported (not yet official on Nov 6) vs Yair Rodriguez at UFC 335, Dec 12, 2026.

photo_coverage: Good; 10 photos. Front: ESPN studio headshot (Jun 2026), Jun 2026 media day (reference-only) and the Jun 12, 2026 Lincoln Memorial photo (public domain, embed-ok). Profile: Oct 2025 faceoff (right side, with the arm tattoos) and two Jun 2026 faceoffs (left side; Cageside and a public-domain White House photo). Physique: Oct 2025 official weigh-in, ESPN cutouts (Oct 2025, Jun 2026) and a Jun 2026 Army photo (full length, in a suit). No fight-action photo of him was found on Commons; the South Lawn set shows other bouts.

face.shape: Broad, squarish-round face: wide across the cheeks and jaw, with fuller cheeks than his lean body suggests. Medium length.
face.jaw: Wide with rounded-square angles; strong under the stubble.
face.brow_ridge: Moderate to strong; heavy brows sit low on it.
face.forehead: Medium height and broad, with faint horizontal creases.

eyes.shape: Almond, smallish, hooded under heavy upper lids; outer corners slightly downturned; mild bags.
eyes.colour: Medium-dark brown. Closest embed iris: brown.

eyebrows.shape: Dark, straight and low, close together at the inner ends (near-joined), slightly lower at the inner ends, which gives a frowning, intense look.

nose.bridge: Broad and slightly flattened at mid-bridge from the front.
nose.hump: Slightly convex in both side profiles (Oct 2025 right, Jun 2026 left).
nose.tip: Wide, rounded and fleshy; wide nostrils.
nose.fight_damage: The broad, slightly flattened bridge is consistent with old breaks; no clear deviation.

face.mouth_lips: Medium width; thin upper lip, medium lower lip; corners slightly downturned at rest (stern expression).

ears.protrusion: Stick out strongly from the head; the most recognisable feature from the front.
ears.cauliflower_ear: Yes, both ears look thickened and smoothed at the upper rim and inner folds (cauliflower), clearest on his left ear in the June 2026 media photo and the studio headshot.

face.notable_marks_scars: Small dark mole on the left cheek (his left), below and outside the left eye (studio headshot and June 2026 media photo).

hair.style: Very short buzz cut (about 1 cm on top) with a high skin fade on the sides and back; a shaved hard-part line on the right side in October 2025.
hair.hairline: Slightly receding at the temples with a rounded central front; shaved short so the scalp shows through.

facial_hair.colour_samples_note: Stubble boxes are mostly skin; colour_hex is judged.
facial_hair.density: Medium on the moustache, chin and jaw line; sparse on the cheeks.
facial_hair.shape: Heavy stubble in a beard pattern: moustache joined to the chin and along the jaw; cheeks mostly clear above a low cheek line.

skin.tone_note: Each sample is the median of a box on well-lit skin (box in source pixels). All three sources run bright (high-key studio, an over-exposed press photo whose forehead clips to #fcd4cc and was left out, and a bright Zuffa weigh-in), so the average may read a little light; the backlit June 2026 faceoff (#b59391, cool and grey) was not sampled.
skin.undertone: Neutral-warm (peach); slight redness on the cheeks and nose.
skin.freckles_marks: Small mole on the left cheek; faint forehead creases; light chest hair.
skin.tone_recommended_note: Judged: the raw average mixes three over-bright sources with a dim night photo. He reads light with a neutral-peach undertone: lighter and less golden than Yair Rodriguez, a touch darker and less pink than Bryce Mitchell.

body.build: Tall and long for featherweight (183 cm with a 190.5 cm reach): long arms, long legs, narrow frame.
body.body_fat_notes: Lean with visible abs and obliques at the October 2025 weigh-in; a little softness at the lower belly in the October 2025 studio cutout.
body.shoulders: Moderate width, sloping; narrow relative to his height.
body.arms: Very long and lean; modest biceps; long forearms.
body.legs_calves: Long legs with lean thighs and slim calves.
body.posture: Upright, shoulders slightly rounded forward, head carried a little forward.
body.notable_physique_traits: Tall, rangy southpaw frame with a reach well beyond his height; buzz cut, protruding cauliflower ears and heavy low brows.

tattoos.where: Back of the right upper arm (triceps / rear shoulder)
tattoos.description: Black-and-grey figurative piece, vertically oriented, with feather- or wing-like shading; details not legible at this resolution.
tattoos.size: About 12 cm tall x 6 cm wide

tattoos.where: Right upper arm, just above the back of the elbow
tattoos.description: Small line of black script or numerals under the triceps piece (not legible).
Black line-work dagger or sword with a cross-guard, the blade running along the forearm toward the wrist.
Small dark mark visible from the front at the October 2025 weigh-in and in the October 2025 cutout; may be part of the forearm piece.

tattoos.where: Right hand, side of one finger (ring or middle finger, near the knuckle)
tattoos.description: Small dark blue-black mark in the June 12, 2026 Lincoln Memorial photo; possibly a small finger tattoo (low confidence, grainy night photo).

tattoos_note: Seen in the October 2025 Zuffa faceoff (right side) and weigh-in photos. The front of the torso, the left arm and the legs look clean in the 2025-2026 studio cutouts and faceoffs.
accessories_seen: Large round pendant on a silver chain and a black band ring on the left ring finger (June 12, 2026 press conference); black wristband on the left wrist at the June 13, 2026 faceoff; sunglasses on the scale (Oct 2025).

kit.typical_shorts: Navy UFC Freedom 250 event shorts with red stars on the waistband, red pinstripes and white stripes, worn with blue 'Freedom 250' gloves (June 2026, one-off); black shorts with a grey and white slash pattern (October 2025 studio shoot); brown briefs on the scale. Fight-night colour follows the corner.

render_hints.eyebrows: eyebrow010 (heavier) tinted #2b1f1a, low and nearly joined
render_hints.hair: buzz cut: no hair mesh, dark scalp shading #2e221c with a high fade
render_hints.beard: stubble #2f231d in a beard pattern, sparse on the cheeks
render_hints.tattoos: right arm only: a single line-work dagger (about 15 cm) on the outer right forearm, not a sleeve; a grey piece about 12 x 6 cm on the back of the right upper arm. Left arm and torso clean.

stance.source: data/scouting/steve-garcia.json (archetype pressure striker, southpaw; tags pressure, power, volume, rangy, fast-starter, wild-exchanges; straight left and low kicks backing opponents to the fence) plus general knowledge of his fight footage. Not measured from these photos.
stance.notes: Long southpaw pressure fighter: walks forward behind a long right hand and the straight left, high output from the opening bell; gets drawn into exchanges with the chin up, so chin_tuck is lower than average.

notes: Confidence: high for the ears, brows, hair, build and right-arm tattoo placement; medium for face proportions; medium for the morph values. What to watch: (1) large, strongly protruding cauliflower ears, his strongest likeness cue (ears/ear-rot-forward and ear-scale carry it); (2) heavy, low, nearly joined dark brows over small, hooded brown eyes; (3) a broad face with full cheeks and a wide jaw on a lean, tall body, so do not slim the face to match the body; (4) broad nose with a wide rounded tip; (5) buzz cut with a high skin fade; (6) tattoos only on the right arm (back of the upper arm, a forearm dagger) plus a possible small finger mark; (7) 183 cm with a 190.5 cm reach, so long arms. The earlier scouting note said 'no tattoos' because the studio cutouts only show the front. The stance block comes from data/scouting and general fight-footage knowledge, not from these photos. ageOldM uses (years-25)/65; l-/r- values are symmetric.
